name: IC — LDO, 4.4V — SOT
description: Surface-mount 4.4V LDO voltage regulator ICs in the SOT package family with SOT-89-3 footprints.
selection_hints: Selecting a 4.4V LDO regulator IC in a surface-mount package.
Requiring a SOT package family footprint such as SOT-89-3.
Choosing Tier A parts from Alternate-KiCad-Library including AP7380-44Y and AP7383-44Y.
avoid_when: A voltage rating other than 4.4V or a non-LDO regulator is required.
The design requires footprints other than SOT-89-3 or non-SOT packages.
Through-hole mounting is needed rather than SMD.
